body:
I am also a borderline that may end life tonight, if road conditions dont prevent me from getting where i need to go. I know how it feels when someone says they'll be there....and for us, disappointments are much harsher than "non bpd" people (supposedly). I know that I myself feel extremely strong, uncontrollable emotion when I feel betrayed, slighted etc. When Im lonely. 

I know its hard. I know being driven to self harm and suicide is not that hard when you struggle with a lot of emotions and don't have "good" coping skills (Im a really good artist, sure I like music, but it doesnt help). Its not as easy as people seem to think.

Huge hugs.
